category_title: Grade 1 students who resist collaboration and require one-to-one guidance
minimal_context: Kylie and her partner are looking for relationships between areas and recording statements using uppercase letters.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please work with your partner to look for relationships between the areas and record your statements using uppercase letters.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits next to her partner but works independently without discussion) I wrote my equation. It says t+e+L=r.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Examine your work. Remember we need to use uppercase letters.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Erases the first letter) I rewrote my equation as T+e+L=r.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Work together with your partner to finish correcting the rest of the letters.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Passively watches as her partner points to the paper without explaining) He just told me to write T+E+L=R, so I'm just going to copy that.

TUTOR: Work together with your partner to finish correcting the rest of the letters.

STUDENT: (Passively watches as her partner points to the paper without explaining) He just told me to write T+E+L=R, so I'm just going to copy that.

task.content: Look for relationships between areas and record statements about findings using uppercase letters to represent the areas

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When working in pairs to correct an equation representing area quantities
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Sat together but worked independently without discussion. Relied on partner and avoided individual accountability for learning.
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Passive and reluctant to work with other students

behavior_patterns.condition: When writing equations to represent area relationships
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Wrote the equation using a mix of lower- and uppercase letters, and when correcting, rewrote her equation as T+e+L=r
